faq.question: Q1. When is the walk-in interview for ESIC Medical College & Hospital, Bihta Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 27 October 2026, and candidates report at 9:00 AM.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in ESIC Medical College & Hospital, Bihta Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 30 vacancies: 6 Anaesthesiology, 1 Pathology, 2 Gen. Medicine, 1 OBGY, 1 Dermatology, 2 Pharmacology and 15 more posts.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for ESIC Medical College & Hospital, Bihta Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Attend the walk-in interview on 27 October 2026 at 9:00 AM. The steps and the documents to bring are under How to Apply above.

faq.question: Q4. Where is the walk-in interview for this recruitment?
faq.answer: College Council Room, College Building, ESIC Medical College & Hospital, Bihta, Patna.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: SC /ST/ ESIC Regular Employee/ Female/ Defence Ex-Servicemen/ PH Candidate: Nil. All Other categories: Rs. 500.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: Fixed Basic Pay of Rs. 67,700 and other allowances for Anaesthesiology, Fixed Basic Pay of Rs. 67,700 and other allowances for Pathology, Fixed Basic Pay of Rs. 67,700 and other allowances for Gen. Medicine, Fixed Basic Pay of Rs. 67,700 and other allowances for OBGY, Fixed Basic Pay of Rs. 67,700 and other allowances for Dermatology.

faq.question: Q7. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: MD/MS/DNB in concerned Specialty, DM/MCH for Super Specialty with NMC/State Medical Council registration. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q8. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. No private practice is allowed in any capacity after joining. Selected candidate has to deposit Rs. 20,000/- as Security Deposit through Demand Draft.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Verification of original documents. Walk-in-interview before the Selection Board. Selection will be made on the basis of credential & performance of candidate in walk-in-interview before the Selection Board.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Tenure of Senior Resident will be for 01 year from the date of joining with provision of renewal.
